MA01.title: The Jubilee
MA01.premise: Pell wants the canal's eightieth year celebrated at the summit with a record day of traffic and a visit from Commissioner Kell; the budget, the water and the truth all get in the way.

stages.name: Plan: Pell announces; Keeper decides scale
Budget: bunting vs repairs; Cole's loan tempts
Ceremony: Kell arrives; a public moment
Aftermath: credit, blame, or a quiet ruin

branch_points: Fund it (coffers-) or refuse (pell-)
Repairs first sets budget_repairs and lowers jubilee_progress
Ceremony during high water risks flood; during survey publication ruins it
MA01.success: jubilee_held with company+, town+; enables end_ord_jubilee.
MA01.failure: jubilee_ruined: company-, pell relationship-, Hesse prints it.
MA01.delayed_consequences: Kell remembers the Keeper (mi20, end cards). Traffic strain feeds MA04.
MA01.exit: Stage 5 card resolves the arc as completed or failed.

MA02.title: The Study
MA02.premise: Dray's locked study holds a ciphered ledger; Mirren, Fennick and Tobin each hold a piece of the key.

stages.name: Locked drawer: open it, or wait for Mirren
Cipher: Mirren admits she has it
Gauge: the sill markings are the key
Key: a brass key stamped S.H.

branch_points: Force the drawer (mirren-) or earn it
Share the cipher with Mirren or work alone
Take the key to the sluice house or give it to Vosk
MA02.failure: Vosk takes the ledger: suspicion+, arc failed, but cipher_progress persists via Ledger.
MA02.delayed_consequences: Fennick's wire copy arrives 5-12 watches after asking.
MA02.cross_run_consequences: p_cipher_progress carries partial decoding between runs.

MA03.title: The Auditor's Interest
MA03.premise: Vosk inspects the Keeper more closely than the accounts deserve, and her interest sharpens around the sluice house.

stages.name: Inspection: the toll book under her eye
Questions: what the Keeper has noticed
The Sluice House: a locked door on the north bank

branch_points: Answer honestly (suspicion+) or evade
Go to the sluice house (clue_sluice_guard) or leave it
Accept the offer (vosk_ally, TE3 path) or refuse (vosk_enemy)
MA03.delayed_consequences: An audit arrives 10-20 watches after a hostile verdict.

MA04.title: Throughput
MA04.premise: Pell's record attempt and Vane's contracts push the gate to cut corners, while Crane counts every breach of the Compact.

stages.name: Reckoning: a near miss or a collision

branch_points: Waive inspections (inspections_waived) or refuse
Allow night passages (night_passages) or not
Reckoning: collision leads to cri_pileup; refusal ends record
MA04.success: Record set: company+, traffic high; Crane's report hostile.
MA04.delayed_consequences: Crane files under the Compact; Aldmere wire 8 watches later.

MA05.title: The Reservoir Sums
MA05.premise: Quenn's figures for the Ninefold Reservoirs never account for the pound; Crane has been counting too.

stages.name: Drawer: Quenn admits the survey copy
Drought or Cut: what the numbers mean

branch_points: Read the survey (read_survey, clue_reservoirs) or leave it
Bring Crane in (clue_crane_counts, crane_recruited)
Publish without the Cut: end_false_drought; with letters or Cut: TE2 path; burn: survey_burned
MA05.delayed_consequences: Vosk reacts 3-6 watches after any publication.

MA06.title: The Water Debt
MA06.premise: Bram's mooring dispute becomes the story of the Hullfolk's origins as Petronel sings the Lowmere Song verse by verse.

stages.name: The outfall: Bram names a place on the north bank

branch_points: Uphold the holding (ilse-, bram+) or the town
Attend the remembrance (honored_remembered)
Promise Bram the debt will be named (promised_bram)
MA06.success: unlock_lowmere_song; hullfolk faction high; TE1 path.
MA06.delayed_consequences: Hullfolk favors return as help during floods.

MA07.title: The Rifle Road
MA07.premise: Wren's reed cargo is rifles for Sorrel; Solas is the buyer, Vane the paymaster, Crane the law.

stages.name: Crate: what is in the reeds
Compact seals: Crane refuses the second seal
Choice: let them through, stop them, or warn Aldmere

branch_points: Protect Wren (wren_protected) or jail her (wren_jailed)
One seal (arms_passed, compact_breached) or hold (arms_held)
sorrel_armed / convoy_stopped / coup_warned
MA07.success: convoy_stopped or coup_warned with Solas kept: solas_owed.
MA07.failure: sorrel_armed: Sorrel faction high, Aldmere hostile; Solas may refuse TE1 in MA12.
MA07.delayed_consequences: Aldmere wire 10 watches after arms pass; Sorrel news 6 watches after stop.

MA08.title: High Water
MA08.premise: The pound is high; cellars and the chapel undercroft flood, the brewery well rises with it, and the undercroft holds Marrow's letters.

stages.name: Undercroft: Hale will not let anyone down
The well: iron and the pound
The letters: what the water uncovered
The charter: 'the water I have given'

branch_points: Open paddles full (paddles_opened_full, water-, traffic-) or sandbag (town labor)
Force the undercroft (hale-) or wait
Take the letters (letters_taken) or leave them
MA08.failure: flood_ignored 3 -> Breach risk; letters lost to water.
MA08.delayed_consequences: Ale sickness 4-8 watches after the well is ignored.

MA09.title: The Vosk File
MA09.premise: Fennick and Hesse can get at Vosk's Y31 file, which proves the Company has known for fifty years.
branch_points: Blackmail Vosk (vosk_confronted, vosk_enemy) or bring it to Crane
Give Hesse the story (hesse_has_story) or hold it
End: unlock_vosk_file; The Promotion path if Company 100
MA09.failure: Fennick exposed (fennick_exposed) and dismissed; Vosk enemy.

MA10.title: The Clearance
MA10.premise: Pell revives the Y44 order to clear the Hullfolk from the Reed Reach; the town is asked to help and Solas is asked to enforce.
branch_points: Sign (clearance_signed) or refuse (clearance_refused)
Ask Solas to enforce: he may refuse (solas_refused_order)
Riot or departure
MA10.success: From Pell's view: hullfolk_cleared -> end_false_clearance available; MA06 blocked.

MA11.title: Into the Cut
MA11.premise: With Dray's key and Bram's knowledge of the outfall, the Keeper enters the Marrow Cut and finds what Dray found.
branch_points: Go alone (risk end_rev_sluice) or with Tamm/Bram
Take Dray's ledger page (cut_mapped)
Tell Mirren (told_mirren) or keep it (mirren_knows_secret_kept)

MA12.title: Last Water
MA12.premise: The Keeper gathers allies and chooses how the truth about the Cut will end: the river returned, the ledger opened, or the cut kept.
branch_points: route_river (Bram, Wren, Solas)
route_ledger (Crane, Quenn, Hesse)
route_cut (Vosk, Hale, Tamm)
MA12.failure: Betrayal or resource edge during the night: crisis endings.

mi25.title: Quenn's Budget
mi25.notes: Coffers; feeds MA01 and water drift.

mi28.title: The Keeper's Chair
mi28.notes: Living in Dray's house; feeds MA02.

mi30.title: The Boundary Stone
mi30.notes: Town warning; feeds MA10 and end_res_town_min.

clues.clue_reservoirs: Reservoir reports never account for the level.
clues.clue_dry_aqueduct: Aqueduct dry in summer while the pound holds.
clues.clue_iron_well: Brewery well tastes of iron and rises with the pound.
clues.clue_song: The Song names a river going into the hill.
clues.clue_charter: Chapel charter thanks Marrow for the water she gave.
clues.clue_sluice_guard: Sluice house guarded harder than a disused valve.
clues.clue_cipher: Dray's ledger cipher keyed to the sill gauge.
clues.clue_night_dredgers: Dry Year crews came at night with no dredgers.
